name: HuggingFace model API: safetensors parameter metadata (per-repo /api/models/<repo>)
notes: The HF model API exposes a safetensors.parameters block computed from the tensor metadata in a repo; the per-repo form is https://huggingface.co/api/models/<owner>/<repo>. This is the authoritative param count for the model records in this slice, not a vendor marketing number. SCOPE CORRECTED 2026-10-30: the url used to be rooted at Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, one arbitrary example repo, and 135 benchmark rows across 9 records cited this id as the source of SCORES. The API returns no benchmark values whatsoever, so those rows pointed at a document that cannot contain them. Each row has been re-pointed at the report, card or table its own config string names, and every new target was read and matched value-by-value in the same pass. This source now backs parameter counts only.
